title: manifest-diff-builder and KMS-stamped attestations for incremental private-installer releases
author: Ava Chen
description: Motivation: make private-installer releases incremental and cryptographically auditable without re-bundling full artifacts for every patch. This PR implements a manifest-diff builder along with KMS-stamped attestations for every delta to enable fast rollforward/rollback and compact provenance storage. Summary: add a new release tool 'manifest-diff' that computes a deterministic delta index between two installer builds, produce a compact delta tarball and an accompanying attest.json signed via customer-configured KMS (supports AWS KMS and Vault HSM). The pipeline integrates the diff artifacts into the release graph and updates release-manifests.yaml with delta entries and signature metadata. Commits summary: 1) initial manifest-diff implementation and tests; 2) KMS attestation client and integration layer; 3) CI pipeline changes to upload delta artifacts to release-bucket and verify attestations in staged job; 4) docs and upgrade notes; 5) small fixes for idempotent replay and key rotation handling. Files changed (high level): tools/manifest-diff/main.go added; tools/manifest-diff/README.md added; internal/release/delta_index.go added; internal/release/attest_kms.go added; ci/pipelines/release-delta.yml modified; charts/installer/values.yaml bumped for delta-recovery hooks; docs/private-installer/release-delta.md added; tests/fixtures/deltas/* added; scripts/verify-attest.sh added. Small illustrative snippet: delta_index entries are structured as {"from":"sha256:...","to":"sha256:...","files":[{"path":"charts/installer.tgz","type":"tar","digest":"sha256:...","size":12345}],"attests":[{"kind":"kms","uri":"awskms://arn:aws:kms:...","sig":"base64..."}]} Highlights and decisions: 1) Use KMS-stamped attestations rather than embedding private keys in CI; CI signs the attestation blob via customer-supplied KMS credential or a staging HSM; 2) Deltas are additive by file path and deterministic by sorted manifest entries to ensure stable signatures; 3) Release manifest schema extended with 'delta_index' block and backward-compatible fields; 4) Added verification step to release pipeline to fail if attestation verification fails. Testing: unit tests for delta computation and attestation verification, integration run against a synthetic release pair, at-scale smoke run on ci-stage with 3 sample deltas. Backwards compat: release consumers that do not understand delta entries will continue to use full artifacts; new clients can fetch and apply deltas. Rollout plan: merge to main, enable opt-in delta builds behind a feature flag in release pipeline for two weeks, run mirror promotion to ensure consumers can fall back to full artifacts. Follow-ups: add in-toto statement mapping and OCI registry push for delta tarballs (ENG-3378), add Vault auto-rotation support. Review thread summary: Bethany Li requested explicit handling for KMS key rotation and a replay protection counter in attestations; author implemented 'key_meta' and 'replay_nonce' fields and added tests. Rishi asked for stronger CI gating; pipeline now has attestation-verify job that runs before artifact-promotion and is green on ci-stage. Diego noted performance concerns for large releases; manifest-diff now streams file lists and avoids loading full file contents into memory. Approvals: Rishi Patel approved after CI green and dex fixes; Bethany Li approved after key rotation tests; Diego Morales approved after small performance tweak. Merge: squashed and merged to main via squash-merge. Release notes: "Adds manifest-diff builder and KMS-stamped attestations enabling incremental private-installer releases and compact provenance. Delta artifacts are optional and gated behind release flag." Associated follow-ups: ENG-3378 for OCI delta registry, ENG-3421 to add Vault auto-rotation. CI Summary: initial lint failed on goimports, fixed in commit 3; one flaky integration test retried and passed; final ci-status is pass. Merge metadata: method=squash, sha=abcd1234efgh, merged_by=Rishi Patel. Additional operational notes: operators should add allowed KMS principals to release pipeline role and rotate keys using the documented key_meta guidelines; a migration script to backfill delta_index for recent 5 releases is included in scripts/backfill-deltas.sh.
